import time
import requests


API_KEY = "cap_live_2a9c30a47d0bbdfde2f4470b61648b0b"
BASE_URL = "https://api.capbypass.pro"


task = {
  "type": "ReCaptchaV3TaskProxyLess",
  "websiteURL": "https://example.com/login",
  "websiteKey": "6LdyC2cUAAAAACGuDKpXeDorzUDWXmdqeg-xy696",
  "pageAction": "login"
}


created = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/createTask", json={"clientKey": API_KEY, "task": task}).json()
if created.get("errorId"):
    raise Exception(f"{created['errorCode']}: {created.get('errorDescription')}")


time.sleep(1)
for _ in range(35):
    result = requests.post(
        f"{BASE_URL}/getTaskResult",
        json={"clientKey": API_KEY, "taskId": created["taskId"]},
    ).json()
    if result.get("status") == "ready":
        print(result["solution"])
        break
    if result.get("errorId"):
        raise Exception(f"{result['errorCode']}: {result.get('errorDescription')}")
    time.sleep(2)
